acs.text_first_line: AC1 One answer for one screening run names the roles, the areas, the letters and the two versions
AC2 The same check a person passes refuses the agent the write it does not hold
AC3 The agent's own profile names its class, its areas, its scope and the two versions
AC4 A person's identity cannot drive the agent path
AC5 Every personal field the run presents is answered masked
AC6 Every answer leaves one access entry with the agent, its policy and its mode
AC7 A new matrix or masking version is answered without a deployment
AC8 An answer that cannot be recorded is not given
AC9 The authority names no table of another service

ops_provided: POST /api/recovery/access/v1/authorise (agent-authority part for one screening run)
ops_consumed: RWB-P10-E1062-CON: the run key, agent code, policy version, autonomy mode, prompt version, the four read tools and the two trigger events, consumed as a shape and never called by this service
rwb-case reference data (DP-07, RWB-P3-E1043-CON): LOV-CAPABILITY, LOV-SCOPE and LOV-ROLE-CLASS at the version in force
rwb-case parameters (DP-06, RWB-P3-E1042-CON): the retention window of an access entry and the switch rwb.access.agent-authority
events_published: the access entry of the answer on rwb.decision-record.v1 through the writer of RWB-P4-E1039-APP; the story adds no event type of its own on rwb.access.events.v1
